new_libraries.name: esp-rtosLogger
new_libraries.author: Hamza Yesilmen <resmiyslmn@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: printf style logging that costs the caller a few microseconds: arguments are queued raw, a FreeRTOS task formats them later.
new_libraries.paragraph: logI("rpm=%d temp=%.2f", rpm, temp) copies the arguments into a 512 byte record and posts it to a static FreeRTOS queue. A low priority task on the core you choose formats the lines with the real snprintf and writes them to Serial, or to any sink you define, batched. Safe from interrupts. Measured 3.2 us p50 per call on an ESP32-S3 at 240 MHz from a 20 kHz loop on the other core. Runs on ESP32 (Arduino-ESP32 3.x) and nRF52 (Adafruit core).

library.name: DevLab_TEMT6000
library.author: UNIT Electronics MX

library.sentence: Arduino library for the TEMT6000 ambient light sensor using the DevLab Device Protocol over I2C.
library.paragraph: DevLab TEMT6000 library for reading ambient light (ADC0) from DDP I2C nodes via DevLabDDP and DevLab_Interface.
